The artists {npc:Percybald} (Carlin) and {npc:Alyxo} (Issavi) give you the {wiki:Royal Costume Outfits|Royal Costume Outfits} and their addons in exchange for donations of {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens} and {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}.
